entry.title: M-One 1.3.0
entry.summary: Korg M1-style workstation for MPC OS 3.10.1+ (Akai Force, MPC One/Live/X/Key, MPC XL, Live III). **Bring your own Korg M1 ROMs** - none are included. **Install** 1. Preferences > Enhancements (Beta): turn on Enable Enhancements and External Plugin Support. 2. Unzip, copy `Fullban - VST - M-One` into `VST2 Plugins` at the top of a drive (internal, SD card or USB). 3. Put your ROM files in `Fullban - VST - M-One/Content/ROMs` (list in the README). Without them M-One is silent and shows NO M1 ROMS.
